prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1048; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my name out of it for now, if that's alright. You can reference the claim number.

Q: That works for the recording. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Katy, Texas, in the right lane. Traffic had been moving slowly all afternoon.

Q: What happened next?

A: The light was still red and I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The car behind me hit me pretty hard.

Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?

A: Yes, we swapped insurance cards and phone numbers. He said he looked down at his phone for a second and didn't see me stop.

Q: Were you taken to a medical facility after the accident?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They did a CT scan and told me I had a concussion.

Q: How are you feeling today?

A: Still pretty rough. I get headaches most afternoons, I'm sensitive to bright lights, and I've had trouble concentrating at work. My doctor has me resting from screens for now.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: Yes, I've been out for about a week and I'm working reduced hours now. I'm keeping all the receipts and doctor's notes.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled properly. I'll send over the medical records you requested.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
